Only seven verified 2D components close. Sequential source updates require multiple explicit passes and resampling.

orderLines/orderco03/polos/spirit require actual SimplexNoise despite blanket worker proposals; cc/telfi retain3D.

cirnoi/fibra/finas/noicir/nosenose use custom value/abs fields; dondon003/limo002/montanon use custom DoubleNoise; these remain unresolved.
erosion combines shifted gamma-shaped fields, forms002d products, acid abs/warps, dondon002 count accumulation and planets3d raster/mesh pipeline are not silently admitted.
win and other unverified cases retain their original gap; missing evidence is not proof of incompatibility.
